name: Ise Kana
source:
"I'm everyone's idol Kana Ise~ Kirat-☆."

An outstanding voice actress who receives considerable attention in the subculture world. Her fan base is thick with her old-fashioned look and liveliness. She has voiced the main characters of animations that are familiar by name, and receives dubbing for foreign films and cartoon animations. There are times when she subconsciously follows the actions of the character she is in charge of, and perhaps thanks to her unique lively personality, she gets along well with everyone, but sometimes gets depressed suddenly, which puzzles those around her.
